profile.headline: Software Engineer at Intel Corporation
profile.geoLocationName: El Dorado Hills, California, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheaded automation development for system validation and developed the platform for development, deployment, and execution across sites leading to reduced time-to-market and exponentially speeding up debug and validation processes.

Integration of new and legacy content/frameworks into internal cloud based test automation management infrastructure and later migrated entire content to Microsoft Azure by working on CI/CD. 

Test plan lead for various projects on both pre and post silicon environments (simulated, emulated, synthetic, and actual silicon). Content, testing methods, timelines, and milestones were defined and consistently relayed to stakeholders.

Designed and developed creative custom software solutions for cross-discipline engineers based on their requirements to make facets of their roles more efficient.

Developed and integrated new method of unifying error reporting from full-chip tests and identifying failures to generate unique signatures and automatically sort into failure bucket databases to query from cloud services.

Mentored new hires and trainee software engineers on best practices and trained on new coding paradigms. Also part of code review committee for Git automation repository that ensured automation would not break.
